title: Pyrrhus
summary: Raleigh names Pyrrhus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Pyrrhus, the sonne of Achilles, who slew Penthesilea at Troy, and whom Orestes afterward slew. He is not Pyrrhus of Macedon. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIV, §. IV, sig. 282a
